evidence.title: CyrusOne Yorkville Technology Campus
evidence.excerpt: CyrusOne's current Yorkville page says the approved technology-campus development is already underway and that site work began in early 2026.

metadata.retrieval_method: Supplied content-decoded HTML capture with separate response headers and request-start timestamp; exact client flags were not recorded in the capture directory.

metadata.source_date_guardrail: The page exposes no trustworthy publication date, so published_at remains null. The 2026-07-19 retrieval date anchors the page's current 'already underway' wording; the July 16 HTTP Last-Modified header is preserved as transport provenance and is not claimed as publication or an exact onsite-observation date.
metadata.status_scope: The current page says site work began in early 2026 and the project is already underway. That supports site_preparation for one current site-work project, but not a building-specific construction stage.
metadata.earlier_infrastructure_context: Water and sanitary improvements beginning in 2025 are retained as context and are not recast as construction of a data-center building.
metadata.plan_changes_guardrail: CyrusOne is seeking approval for changes to building area, story count, and setbacks. Those proposed revisions remain metadata and do not create approved project geometry, a new building inventory, or a lifecycle claim.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The expected late-2027 first-building completion and 2028 full-operations date are forecasts, not completion, commissioning, or operation observations.
metadata.economic_guardrail: Investment, jobs, taxes, scholarships, community benefits, operational staffing, and related economic claims are not power, energy, PUE, capacity, workload, operating-model, tenant, user, or role observations.
metadata.template_guardrail: Unrelated placeholder construction-timeline and Bosque County content embedded in the page template is not treated as Yorkville evidence.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: The authoritative Yorkville locality is retained without geocoding. Eldamain and Faxon Road references do not establish a street address, parcel, footprint, coordinate, or unique site; coordinates and geometry remain null.
